description: This 3D model depicts a spiral staircase with a modern, minimalist design. The staircase features a light wooden construction for the steps, creating a warm and inviting aesthetic. It appears to be enclosed within a transparent, glass-like structure, suggesting an indoor or semi-outdoor installation, possibly in a contemporary architectural setting. A single, thin, light-colored pole stands vertically in the center of the upper platform, potentially serving as a structural element or a decorative accent. The overall presentation is clean and geometric, emphasizing functionality and a sleek visual appeal. The base is a flat, grey surface, which could represent the ground or a floor.
